svg.title: wtr-max-fans safety layers: what happens when each piece fails

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Safety layers: every failure moves towards more air, never less

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What happens when each piece fails. The controller and the guard are separate processes with separate restart policies.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both curves are already at 255 (100 %) from 52 °C: the controller has nothing left to add.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wtr-guardia-discos, a separate process on a 30 s cycle, writes 255 to both channels itself

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and tells the controller to stand back. Released once every disk is below 50 °C.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A disk reads ≥ 58 °C three times in a row and a second disk ≥ 50 °C

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clean shutdown: shutdown -h +1 (one minute to cancel), then systemctl poweroff, then sysrq.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One hot disk alone, or any suspicious reading: full air plus a critical alert, no shutdown.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The controller crashes, hangs or is killed

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The chip stays in automatic mode with the last Start PWM (never below the floor).

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ExecStopPost writes the backup 153 / 77 within seconds; systemd restarts it after 30 s.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The driver is not loaded, or the patch is missing (new kernel)

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The controller exits with code 78 and writes nothing. The guard keeps watching; its last resort is

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pwmN_enable=0 (100 % in manual mode), sticky until wtr-guardia-discos reconocer after a rebuild.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No module and no service (for example a reboot into a kernel without it)

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The firmware curve applies. Recommended BIOS fallback: rear Start PWM 60 %, base 30 %.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Thresholds 50 / 52 / 54 / 58 °C sit below the disks' 60 °C specification limit. The CPU fan and the 2-wire MEM header are never touched.
